exact_diff_check.method: Read current and committed snapshot text, normalize CRLF/LF, reverse only the two exact added blocks, and compare all remaining text case-sensitively. Both exact blocks appeared once. All 18 snapshot/current pairs were SHA256 checked; only the intended cpp differs.
exact_diff_check.finding: Braces/comment/helper added before the same existing returns. No change to success condition, native dispatch ordering, history commit ordering, debug/bypass returns, earlier failures or exception handling.

failure_closure_trace.finding: Both changed false branches occur after CommitDenoiserHistory on a successful RR prefix. Guard success is still false on either exit; the assignment at2079 is not reached. Invalidation is therefore applied before an unchanged false closure.

Existing noexcept helper invalidates converter history if present, sets native CPU valid=false and resets the diagnostic last-reset latch. It does not erase previous camera/jitter storage, record a GPU clear, destroy resources or call native dispatch.

Helper sets composition valid/pending false. Existing guard then Finish(false) sets those same flags false. This is idempotent and cannot flip historyRead because successfulNormalFrame is false. The helper's pending=false also prevents a flip if pending storage was set by the failed frame before upscale returned false.
Existing EvaluationFrameGuard still advances frameCount once on scoped failure; the patch does not roll back/reuse a native frame index.

next_successful_rr_setup_trace.finding: Next Evaluate refreshes title Reset normally, then PrepareDenoiserInput first prepares conversion inputs and records conversion before constructing native dispatch. _hasDenoiserHistory remains false until a subsequent successful native commit; title Reset=0 does not re-enable it.
PrepareDenoiseConvInput uses current jitter as previous when native CPU valid=false, packs XY=ZW, sets MotionHistoryValid=false, then resolves camera matrices.

With a usable current camera, ResolveCameraMatrices assigns previous view=current view on reset/no native history. ConvertDenoiserBuffers packs that previous matrix into conversion constants. Invalid camera still fails setup through existing validation; patch promises reset flags only on the next valid setup, not on every attempted call.

RefreshHistoryDerivedInputs runs after existing change checks and before conversion dispatch, reinforcing MotionHistoryValid=false and previous jitter=current. This prevents another setup producer from restoring stale derived flags.

Conversion constants receive refreshed view/jitter. MotionHistoryValid=false also invalidates helper history; copied motion-valid flag remains false, jitter-history delta becomes zero, and normal composition HistoryValid evaluates to0.

Native resetHistory is true from !_hasDenoiserHistory. cameraPositionDelta is explicitly zero, FFX_DENOISER_DISPATCH_RESET is ORed into flags, and current jitter is passed to native RR. Existing resource validation may prevent dispatch; a failed setup does not falsely commit history.
Once a later native dispatch records successfully, existing commit saves current camera/view/jitter and re-enables native history. Normal successful composition closure remains at2079/2080.

contracts_preserved.finding: Existing early debug true and normal/debug/bypass success predicates are untouched. Composition success is not reused as a generic native-failure predicate, so successful bypass does not gain a new reset.
Core false still propagates false. Optional postprocessing false still returns true; overlay status remains ignored. No new optional-stage failure semantic or FSRD notification was added.
Existing wrapper failure logging/root restoration and mapping to NGX result are unchanged.
SR upscaler reset still follows title _isInReset. Existing native-upscale runtime-error recreation remains unchanged; helper does not reset the SR context or add global/backend changes.

risks_and_limits: Intentional quality tradeoff: if caller submits a failed frame's valid RR prefix, its native history might have been usable. The new helper conservatively abandons accumulation on the next RR call; source review does not measure that transient quality cost.

This covers reported composition/upscale bool failures. It does not observe a successful evaluation later discarded/reset without submission, repair already-recorded successors, or solve CB/descriptor/resource lifetime and ordering issues.

The helper changes CPU flags only. It does not retroactively change recorded GPU commands or free pending resources. Valid ordered execution and feature lifetime remain the pre-existing caller contract.

XY title motion is not zeroed by this policy; the relevant derived MotionHistoryValid flag is false, previous view/current view and previous/current jitter agree, and native camera delta is zero. Do not broaden this into a claim that every motion-channel value is zero.
Exception handling and other early returns are unchanged. Existing exceptions outside checked bool branches are not converted into new failures/reset handling by this eight-line patch.

Native RESET is established by source control flow. Full native reset effectiveness, release compilation and visual quality require separate validation. No production stain/wave cause or game fix is established.
